Keyboard Alignment

Sweep (QMK, wired) and gil (ZMK, Urchin, wireless): where the two keymaps match, where they still differ, and what we are aiming for. Generated from both keymap files by docs/layout_page.py, so it is always current.

Atap Ctrlhold ▽falls through to the layer below does nothing differs between the boards F20 thumb: double tap = one F20, triple tap = two, tap then hold = F20 held

The plan

Principle: layers 0–7 identical on both boards: typing, symbols, navigation, numbers, F-keys, macros, and media + mouse on layer 7. Layer 8 is the one place each board keeps its own hardware controls: RGB lighting on the Sweep; Bluetooth, USB/BT output, external power and soft-off on gil. Bootloader and reset are on both halves of layers 7 and 8, because ZMK reboots the half the key is on.
